result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues are visible: truncated restaurant names, cut-off category chips and promo text, and a partially obscured bottom card. These reduce scannability and make key info hard to read.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line names, reduce font size, or ensure cards show full titles with ellipsis only when necessary and with accessible full name.

issues.description: Category filter chips overflow the screen; the last chip is partially cut off on the right.
issues.suggestion: Make the chip row horizontally scrollable with clear fade/peek of the next item, or wrap/resize chips so all labels are fully visible.

issues.description: Promo banner body text is cramped and appears cut off mid-line ('min. order €10' runs into the edge / hard to read).
issues.suggestion: Increase padding, allow text to wrap cleanly, and ensure the full offer copy and CTA remain fully visible on small widths.

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card (pizza) is heavily cropped by the viewport/nav bar, so most of the image and details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding above the tab bar so cards aren’t obscured; ensure list scroll area accounts for safe area + tab height.

issues.description: Delivery time badges sit over food imagery with limited contrast/padding variation, and heart icons float without strong affordance.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge contrast and positioning; give favorite controls a clearer hit target and background for visibility.
